title: Easier paths through the forests
changes: Trees now only block their trunk, not a whole square: you round them smoothly and slip between trees that only touch at a corner.
Deep in the Whispering Woods and the Thornwood, many trunks are slim enough to squeeze past, so winding ways open through the thick forest.
Clicking to walk through a forest takes a much more direct route, and a click right beside a trunk walks you there.
